name: NG exhaustion aftermath causal validation freeze
scope: second independent aftermath/transition research only; completed runway clock and permanent Frankie are untouchable

methodological_correction.exploratory_issue: The preserved exploratory next-event percentages ordered reveal events only against the next reveal event and held-out events only against the next held-out event. This can skip a real intervening exhaustion in the other half.
methodological_correction.correct_outcome_order: Order the full 3429-event substantive population by day and t0. For every anchor, the literal next event is the next detected event in that full chronological stream regardless of reveal/holdout membership.
methodological_correction.causal_timing_issue: Any feature using observations through t0+60 cannot predict an event whose t0 is at or before t0+60.
methodological_correction.direct_second_order_eligibility: For +60 transition rules, score the literal next event only when next_t0 > t0+60. Otherwise mark the direct second-order target already realized before the decision boundary and do not score it as a causal prediction.

episode_endpoint_policy.orientation: multiply raw roll20 by the anchor exhaustion polarity
episode_endpoint_policy.termination: first three consecutive causal seconds after t0 with oriented roll20 <= 0
episode_endpoint_policy.missing_seconds: forward-fill only from the most recent finite roll20 already observed; never use future back-fill after t0
episode_endpoint_policy.session_end_behavior: If termination never occurs before the raw session ends, mark endpoint censored. Never manufacture an endpoint.
episode_endpoint_policy.relationship_to_plus60: +60 is a legal state/checkpoint boundary for the frozen A classifier, not an exhaustion endpoint.

target1.primary_direct_target: polarity of the literal next detected exhaustion in the full chronological stream, scored only if that next event is still future at the feature as-of time

predeclared_states.alive_through_60: No three-consecutive-second oriented roll20 <= 0 termination by +60
predeclared_states.late_flow_same: Volume-weighted aligned aggressor pressure over +41..+60 is > 0
predeclared_states.late_flow_opposite: Volume-weighted aligned aggressor pressure over +41..+60 is < 0
predeclared_states.late_flow_zero_or_sparse: No classified aggressor volume over +41..+60 or exactly balanced pressure

target1.threshold_selection: No held-out-optimized numeric cut. Primary validation uses sign-only late-flow states plus the alive/collapsed state. Quantile and monotone tables are descriptive secondary analyses.

target2.anchor: dynamic episode endpoint above, never t0+60 by fiat
target2.signed_price_displacement: anchor polarity * (future carried-forward last-trade price - endpoint carried-forward last-trade price) / 0.001
target2.excursions: MFE/MAE measured over each fixed post-end horizon
target2.first_hit_times: First +3t, -3t, +5t, -5t after endpoint are scanned without a time cap and censored only at session end
target2.next_exhaustion: first detected exhaustion whose t0 is strictly after the dynamic endpoint

chain_research_gate.start_only_after: Target 1 causal validation and Target 2 dynamic-end aftermath are measured under this freeze
chain_research_gate.principle: A later event belongs to the inherited chain only while measurable dependence on the originating state survives; otherwise mark a reset and start a new first-order chain.
